because you -CANNOT- trust labs not to intentionally or accidentally benchmaxx, you need a few trusted third parties to basically redo the entire eval in spirit but not in letter, to have a quick sniff test that model claims hold up under minor perturbations (eg starting from "randomizing order in multiple choice questions" to coming up with completely new problems that superficially look different but actually test the same underlying logic and reasoning steps). not enough people are reading bench traces like this 👇  and the systematic way to catch this benchmaxxing is basically to have altbenches for everything
